table_3_1_13_2_wall_ceiling_finishes.location: Group A, Division 1 occupancies (incl. doors, skylights, glazing, light diffusers and lenses)
Covered vehicular passageways (except heavy-timber roof assemblies in the passageways)

general_cap: 3.1.13.2.(1): flame-spread rating of interior wall and ceiling finishes shall not exceed 150 unless Table 3.1.13.2 or another article requires less.

wall.not_sprinklered: 75 (or the waiver option: 25 on the upper half of the wall and 150 on the lower half)

corridor_scope: 3.1.13.6 applies to public corridors, corridors used by the public in assembly occupancies, and corridors serving classrooms; the ratings apply to the occupancies in the corridor as well as the corridor itself.

high_building_table_3_1_13_7.location: Exit stairways, vestibules to exit stairs, lobbies per 3.4.4.2.(2)

high_building_note: 3.1.13.7.(2): except for Group B buildings and elevator cars, Table 3.1.13.7 need not be met if the building is sprinklered.
related_rules: Doors (other than in Group A Div. 1): need not meet Table 3.1.13.2 if FSR <= 200 - 3.1.13.2.(2). Doors within a dwelling unit are exempt - (3).
Area allowance - 3.1.13.2.(4): up to 10% of wall area and 10% of ceiling area of a finish required to be < 150 may be up to 150; for 3.4.4.2.(2) lobbies, up to 25% of wall area may be 150.
Light diffusers and lenses (all occupancies except A-1): may exceed the table if FSR <= 250 and smoke developed classification <= 600 (CAN/ULC-S102.2), subject to conditions - 3.1.13.4.(1).
Exterior exit passageways (only means of egress): wall/ceiling FSR <= 25, with 150 permitted for <= 10% of wall and ceiling area - 3.1.13.10.(1).
Elevator cars: walls/ceilings FSR <= 75; wall, ceiling and floor smoke developed classification <= 450 - 3.1.13.11.
Outside high buildings there is no general smoke-developed table in 3.1.13; SDC limits appear only in specific articles (light diffusers 600, elevator cars 450).
